summary: Reduce repeated mailbox report fence reads and expose fence-check caller counts and durations

replay.detail: Mailbox replay proof, immediate incarnation revocation and writer-side admission checks are preserved; no verdict cache is introduced.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, canonical ordering, repair membership or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing mailbox frames, report authentication and ownership contracts remain unchanged. Ordinary report admission reuses one consistent read snapshot rather than repeating the full store fence.

downtime.detail: No migration or additional startup work.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Mailbox fence metrics distinguish reports, graph-change dirty passes, heartbeats and safety rechecks.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
